$comment: Scenario catalogue (#612): reference scenarios a company can copy into its data file from Test Config. Each entry names the scenario of simulator_datafile.json that supplies its data (source), says what it tests (purpose), and gives the number of checks it produced on the OSDM simulator (checks, from node OSDM_Simulator/scripts/replay.js). set changes only the *MaxWaitMinutes waits, for a real provider. Kept sound by Oscar_Server/tests/unit/scenario-catalogue.test.js.

entries.purpose: One-way sale for one adult: offers, booking, passenger update, confirmation, documents.
One-way sale for two adults, choosing the non-flexible (saver) offer.
Return sold as two offers, one per direction (returnSearchParameters.outwardOfferIds).
Return sold as one offer covering both directions (outboundTripIds, OSDM 3.7 and later).
Full refund of a return: every refund offer confirmed, every fulfillment refunded.
Partial refund of a return by fulfillment: the inbound ticket alone.
Technical cancellation: refund with an overrule code, everything back and no fee.
Negative probe: a refund with an overrule code the provider does not accept must be refused.
Refund offer asked for, then withdrawn instead of confirmed: the ticket stays.
Refund offer asked for and read, neither confirmed nor withdrawn.
Full refund of a return, then the refund receipt waited for in the booking.
Exchange of a one-way ticket: exchange offers, one taken, confirmed.
Exchange pre-booked, then withdrawn before its confirmation: the ticket stays.
Travel class per leg on a two-leg trip: first class where the train has one.
A mandatory seat reservation, detected from the admission and booked with it.
An optional seat reservation booked with optionalReservationSelections.
An optional seat reservation booked with placeSelections.
An optional seat reservation added to the pre-booked booking afterwards.
Offers asked by trip id, after a trip search (POST /trips-collection).
Negative probe: offers asked for a trip id the provider never gave must be refused.
Fulfillment documents of a return, and each fulfillment read with GET /fulfillments/{id}.
Idempotency-Key on the booking and the confirmation: the same key gives the same answer.
Negative probe: booking an offer after its preBookableUntil must be refused.
Negative probe: confirming a booking after its confirmation time limit must be refused.
Negative probe: confirming a refund offer after its validUntil must be refused.
Negative probe: taking an exchange offer after its preBookableUntil must be refused.
Requested information: what the offers ask for is checked and supplied.
Negative probe: a passenger update without a demanded field must be refused.
Negative probe: a passenger update with an invalid field, one field per pass, must be refused.
Booking made without its purchaser, which is written afterwards.
Negative probe: a purchaser with a missing or invalid field, one per pass, must be refused.
